decisive_items: Cell differential: 1% lymphocytes, 1% monocytes/macrophages, 98% atypical cells/blasts
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
response.rationale: Leukemia cutis and CSF blasts are pathognomonic for leukemia; nerve root enhancement reflects leukemic infiltration. Leptomeningeal disease is a secondary pattern, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Neurolymphomatosis implies lymphoma, but no lymphoma-specific evidence; leukemia cutis and blasts favor leukemia.
Cauda equina syndrome is a clinical syndrome, not the underlying neoplastic cause.
